messages:
devin: Anyone bringing a Switch to the office tomorrow for a quick lunchtime Smash tourney? I can bring a dock + extra JoyCon.

sophia: Ooh yes! What time were you thinking? :smile:

jim: Count me in, casuals only please :sweat_smile: I get frustrated real fast.

maria: I can bring Mario Kart carts and a USB-C charger. Also low-key down for some Rocket League on Steam if anyone wants to queue later.

alex: I only have a handheld Switch Lite — is that okay or do you need full-console players?

devin: Handhelds totally fine. We'll set up in Conf A so people can plug into HDMI if they have it. Thinking noon to 1:30 for Smash bracket, then freeplay.

sophia: Noon works for me. Quick signup so we know controllers:```
1. Devin - dock + extra JC (left only?)
2. Sophia - controller + casual
3. Jim - brings snacks
4. Maria - Mario Kart carts
5. Alex - Switch Lite
```

devin: Nice. I'll bring a small USB-C hub and the HDMI cable. If anyone has a pro controller they prefer, bring it.

tara: We have an extra USB hub in the equipment closet (labelled "AV spares"). @devin if you want I can grab it before lunch.

devin: Oh sweet, thanks @tara :raised_hands: That should cover it.

jim: Also bringing chips and a little prize (Steam gift card) for the winner. Low-stakes but tasty. :tada:

alex: If there's spare time after, anyone up for a 2v2 Rocket League party? I can host a lobby on Steam.

maria: Love that. Putting my name down for Rocket League as backup.

sophia: I'll come even if I just watch and heckle. :joy:

devin: Perfect. See y'all noon in Conf A. If plans change I'll post here. :thumbsup:
